name: Rajesh Acharya
bio: Rajesh founded Summit Abroad in 2010 after completing his own master's degree in Australia. He holds QEAC certification and has personally counseled over 1,000 students. His expertise spans Australian Subclass 500 visas and UK student visa applications.
qualifications: M.Sc. International Education Management, University of Melbourne

name: Sita Karki
bio: Sita leads our visa team with a meticulous approach to documentation that has resulted in a 98% visa success rate. She specialises in Canadian Study Permits and US F-1 visas, with deep expertise in financial documentation and GTE writing.
qualifications: Immigration Law Certificate, Kathmandu School of Law

name: Manish Poudel
bio: Manish studied engineering in Germany and brings firsthand knowledge of the European education system. He specialises in German university applications, APS certification, and TestDaF coaching — having guided 300+ students to European institutions.

name: Anita Tamang
bio: Anita is a PIER-accredited IELTS instructor with an IELTS score of 8.5. She has trained over 2,000 students and consistently achieves above-target band scores with her students. Her writing correction methodology is particularly recognised among students.
qualifications: M.A. English Language Teaching, Kathmandu University

name: Bikash Thapa
bio: Bikash studied in the UK and specialises in postgraduate and MBA applications to UK and Irish universities. He has strong relationships with admissions offices at over 20 UK universities and regularly attends university education fairs on behalf of students.

name: Priya Rana
bio: Priya coordinates all university application submissions and ensures every student file is complete and compelling. She has edited over 500 SOPs and is known for her eagle-eye attention to detail and quick turnaround time.
qualifications: Certificate in Academic Writing, British Council

name: Suraj Magar
bio: Suraj is a PTE Expert certified trainer with a PTE score of 88. He specialises in the computer-based English tests and has an exceptional record of getting students to their target PTE scores within a single preparation cycle.

name: Luna Shrestha
bio: Luna manages all pre-departure orientations and maintains the Summit Abroad alumni network across 15 countries. She is the first point of contact for students after arrival and coordinates with on-ground alumni to ensure a smooth transition.
